reason: ADD: 744 MW gas plant (Takanock / Montera) co-located with the Project Eagle data center in Glendale/Waddell, AZ. BTM ANALYSIS: NOT excluded under the standing rule — Baccara will sell power to the grid / local electrical district and connect to an APS substation (by 2030); the data center is initially served by an interim utility (grid) connection. The grid connection is not entirely accounted for by the co-located load, and the generation is independently grid-connected, so it counts in full. Counter-consideration: Maricopa County initially treated plant + data center as a single emissions source because the plant exists mostly to serve the data center initially. Jun 2028 is a placeholder (construction from 2026; first data center early 2028). Not in EIA Planned.
